last_amend_reason: ESC-010, approved by Hank in the cycle-14 turn ('I approve'). tickets.json only: the 'verify' field on the seven greenfield tickets T-032/T-034/T-035/T-042/T-043/T-044/T-045. WHAT WAS WRONG: each declared a gate naming a test file the LANE ITSELF had to create, so at the merge base pytest exits 4 with ZERO tests selected and red-check stamps WEAK -- 'the gate proved nothing about this ticket either way'. That stamp is a fact about the COMMAND, not the branch, so re-running re-stamps WEAK forever and check-branch refused six finished branches carrying 9917 lines. WHAT REPLACES IT: each ticket's gate now selects the ticket's OWN frozen acceptance tests -- the ones it is actually graded by, which exist and fail before the work -- using the runner's own --confcutdir escape, because raw pytest cannot run the frozen suite at all (the root conftest aborts on unset PROXYSHOP_WORKER) and run.py has no failing exit mode (it prints numbers and exits 0 even with failures). THIS STRENGTHENS THE GATE, IT DOES NOT WEAKEN IT: the old commands discriminated in NEITHER direction; each new one is measured red-at-base with the exact expected number of tests SELECTED, not merely non-zero exit. Verified on the tree at e13524c before applying, every one: T-032 8 failed/21 deselected, T-034 3 failed, T-035 1 failed, T-042 3 failed, T-043 3 failed, T-044 8 failed, T-045 1 failed. T-044 additionally verified GREEN on its finished branch (same 8 selected, 8 passed), so that gate is proven to discriminate in both directions. One caution recorded: my first verification harness reported T-032 as 'no tests ran' -- that was a bug in my own shell wrapper, not in the gate; run directly the same expression selects 8 and fails 8. A verification harness that produces a confident wrong answer is the same failure mode two of this cycle's lane verifiers reported about themselves. No metric, target, acceptance test, product file or dependency changed; graph verify-fields only.
